organization.name: Rebuilding Together San Francisco
organization.scope: San Francisco; local affiliate, not national Rebuilding Together
organization.program: Proposed skilled fall-hazard modification expansion within actual home-repair services

unit.costDenominator: one eligible enrolled household allocated a complete intended course, including failed visits and noncompletion costs
unit.healthDenominator: one high-risk community-dwelling adult age 65+ per enrolled household
unit.population: Prior fall or concern about falling plus actionable hazards; severe cognitive impairment requires separate evidence
unit.intervention: Skilled OT-equivalent assessment, tailored installation/removal and behavior training, six-month booster
unit.comparator: Existing funded repairs, usual care, landlord obligations and substitute fall prevention without the gift

currency.basis: Illustrative analyst budgets, not inflation-adjusted trial costs or provider quotes

harp.limits: Rounded crude rate difference is secondary all-falls, not adjusted absolute effect, serious injuries or fall-free probability. Primary first-fall and HRQoL outcomes were null. HRQoL score is not preference utility. No reported adverse events does not prove zero local harm. Historical St Louis delivery cost is orientation only.

otisClinical.limits: Assessment with recommended/provided modifications differs from HARP; substantial contrary evidence, not merely a leaflet comparator.

otisEconomic.limits: EQ-5D-derived integrated utility, UK NHS/PSS perspective. Net payer cost is not delivery price. Not a measured RTSF effect or a coefficient to add to HARP.

rtsfServices.facts: Year-round modifications, mobility/safety and MOHCD-supported fall-prevention installations; page also says Senior Home Repair intake closed.

rtsfApplications.facts: Rolling applications; existing funding to serve 100 people before December 31, 2026; income and tenure/landlord documentation.
rtsfApplications.limits: 100 is funded baseline, not verified unfunded places or confirmed remaining slots.

recipient.facts: Names Rebuilding Together San Francisco, EIN 94-3107808; general recipient, not a priced restricted offer.

clinicalTransfer.meaning: Protocol/population/local engagement transport and conflicting trial evidence; not funding

effectiveYears.meaning: Integrated retained exposure within core one-year horizon; pessimistic 0.5 is attenuation, not a six-month measurement

expectedQalyLossPerFall.meaning: Averages harmless and injurious prevented events and consequences within episode, including late-fall timing/truncation; no lifetime tail. Repeat-event overlap may overstate linear benefit

fundingAdditionality.meaning: Share of net health created beyond already-funded delivery/substitutes; not public revenue share

incrementalHarmQaly.meaning: Subtract before multiplying funding. OTIS magnitude in isolated harm stress is external illustration only

directDeliveryResourceCostUsd.meaning: Complete direct resources including paid or replacement-valued donated labor/materials; not verified cash price

conditionalDonorCashCostUsd.meaning: Equal to direct resources only in core assumption that donor finances all inputs. Actual marginal gift cash price remains unknown

costs.decompositionEvidence: All judgments; $300 skilled allowance is lean and may be inadequate
costs.scenarioEndpoints: Independent whole-course budgets, not products of source cost confidence bounds

cashVersusDonatedResources.accounting: For a verified expansion, donor cash = full direct resource cost - incremental non-donor paid financing - incremental in-kind replacement value, if categories are disjoint. Keep full resources in the resource view. Do not subtract already-funded baseline as though it were induced cofunding.
cashVersusDonatedResources.warning: Volunteer input is not free. Core donor-cash numbers are conditional paid-equivalent illustrations, not observed gifts. Funding additionality adjusts health, not resource valuation.

scenarioInterpretation: Joint planning scenarios, not confidence bounds or posterior probabilities. Positive central is judgmental despite null primary/utility results.

stressTests.interpretation: Replaces positive bridge; not additive trial effects, not observed RTSF harm
Unobserved second year, no added maintenance or discounting. Not ranking input; requires separate persistence/survival/maintenance evidence.
Funding multiplies both intervention benefit and harm

fundingRoom.currentPublicBaseline: Funding already announced for 100 people by 2026-12-31, not a donor opportunity count
fundingRoom.programPageDiscrepancy: Service page closure versus application page rolling intake; no universal closure inferred
constraints: Exact marginal course price and cohort

ranking.pricePerspective: Conditional all-direct-input donor cash / attributed health, equal to direct resources under no-subsidy assumption

safeguards: Count one adult per household; no automatic household multiplier
No extra mortality, fear, fracture, housing, caregiver or institutionalization bonus
Do not infer health durability from physical fixture lifespan
No extra adherence multiplier without redefining relative engagement
Do not assign fracture QALYs to every fall
Identical replacement makes both benefit and intervention harm zero
Nonpositive QALYs have no attractive negative price
No double counting shared household modifications or overlapping exercise effects

supersedes.reason: Below historical trial cost plus unverified two-year persistence
supersedes.newTreatment: Two-year stress only; one-year favorable core is 266666.6666666667
